descricao: The surroundings of Level 5 are littered with decorations and furniture from the early 20th century, with The Main Hall being the most object-populated area of Level 5. The level is mostly clean, with little dust and dirt lingering on surfaces. It seems to clean itself, as unclean spots disappear only a few minutes after appearing. The oddly pristine floors and well-cared-for areas make Level 5 utterly unsettling when compared to other levels close by.
